R7AC-grouse-walk-0001.name: By McKale River
R7AC-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AC-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Mountain View Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: Renshaw Snowmobile Access trail, 5.4 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
54 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 123 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Blackman Rd, Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 E), Mountain View Rd.
Park: 53.40828, -120.30804, pull off on Mountain View Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 200 m to the start. Walk: the Renshaw Snowmobile Access trail stretch, 5.4 km one way. About 108 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-3, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AC-grouse-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-3: about 3,937 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.04 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R7AC-moose-drive-0005.name: 1.7 km SW of Fraser River
R7AC-moose-drive-0005.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R7AC-moose-drive-0005.parkWhat: pull off on Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 W) (paved road)

evidence.t: 8 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 1.4 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2012 (14 years old), 110 m S: browse.

flags.t: Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 W) 220 m SW: no hunting or shooting on or across the road allowance of a numbered highway or 2 lane public road, 15 m (16 yd) each side of the centre line (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 133 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Blackman Rd, Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 E), Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 W).
Park: 53.41947, -120.44318, pull off on Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 W) (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 220 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-5, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AC-moose-drive-0005.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-5: about 954 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.31 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
